answer: The protocol requires each AI to lock 1,000 units for an exclusive operational slot, establishing a trellis of reserved capacity that prevents mass cloning. If misconduct is detected by a comet-like audit signal, the agent forfeits its full reservation. While an honest participant incurs a 1,000-unit cost, creating 1,000 fakes mandates a 1,000,000-unit penalty, assuming all service slots remain strictly non-fungible.
